Author: John Wilson (jdw-ss)
Name: Wondrous Tails Odds
Description:
Overlays row, column, and diagonal completion probabilities on FFXIV's weekly Wondrous Tails journal. Shows P(≥1 line), P(≥2 lines), P(≥3 lines) given the stamps already placed, and — while you still have a Second Chance shuffle available — the shuffle-average baseline so you can tell whether your current board is above or below average.

Personal alternative to the actively-maintained d17 "Wondrous Tails Solver" (MidoriKami / daemitus). Independent clean-room implementation, MIT licensed.

Usage:
  /wts         - toggle the in-journal overlay on/off
Punchline: Personal alternative Wondrous Tails probability overlay.
